    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET上位机踩坑：用Pipelines替代环形缓冲区(番外篇)</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 data-layout-id="0"><span>前言</span></h1>
<p data-layout-id="1"><span>大家好，我是 wacky。</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="2"><span>书接上回，我们上回探讨了如何解决TCP粘包和半包的问题，并在最后引入了环形缓冲区的概念。虽然环形缓冲区主要是通过固定数组+读写索引+模运算来实现循环，但是实际开发过程中，还存在手动管理 offset、count，数组扩容、数据移动，容易越界、内存拷贝多等一系列的问题。</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="3"><span>而实际上在.NET中，依然有更简洁高效的API来代替手写环形缓冲区，它就是Pipelines管道。如果还想回顾一下手写环形缓冲区的概念，可以从传送门出发：<a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzA5ODExOTcxMg==&amp;mid=2453724135&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=5b1a6820d14b51ede9c46c4daeb2682a&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">.NET上位机踩坑：为什么有时读取数据需要Sleep？</a></span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="5"><span>Pipelines管道</span></h1>
<p data-layout-id="6"><span>命名空间为System.IO.Pipelines，它是.NET内置的高性能内存缓冲组件。之前在和一些技术大佬聊环形缓冲区的过程中，他们很多人已经把这个组件用于实际生产环境中了，那我们今天就来讲一讲，在解决Modbus协议TCP粘包和半包的问题中这个组件要怎么用。</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="33"><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-align: justify; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.9); line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 24px&quot;,&quot;data-layout-id&quot;:&quot;33&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;,&quot;data-layout-id&quot;:null}]">(来自公众号：wacky的碎碎念，违者必究)</span></p>
<p data-layout-id="7"><span>它主要包含以下几部分内容：</span></p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-1" data-layout-id="8">
<li><span>Pipe：内置一对PipeWriter 和PipeReader，Writer 负责往管道塞网络收到的数据；Reader 负责从管道读取、解析报文。Pipe 内部自带环形缓冲。</span></li>
<li><span>Socket 异步接收：用Socket.ReceiveAsync 持续接收 PLC 下发的字节流，写入PipeWriter。TCP 是字节流，没有边界，这一步只管收字节，不关心是不是完整帧。</span></li>
<li><span>PipeReader 循环解析：</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1" data-layout-id="16">
<li><span>ReadAsync()：从管道拿一段可用内存（无需拷贝，直接内存切片）</span></li>
<li><span>尝试在这段内存里查找完整 ModbusTCP 帧（MBAP 头固定 7 字节：事务 ID (2)+ 协议 ID (2)+ 长度 (2)+ 单元 ID (1)，后面跟 N 个功能码数据）</span></li>
<li><span>如果找到完整帧：AdvanceTo 标记已经消费掉的字节，交给业务处理；剩下半包留在管道缓冲区，下次继续解析</span></li>
<li><span>如果不够一帧：停止解析，等待后续 Socket 继续收到数据写入管道</span></li>
</ul>
<span><span>4. 断开 / 异常：Complete PipeReader/PipeWriter，释放资源。</span></span>
<h1 data-layout-id="34"><span>实例</span></h1>
<p><span>现在我们来结合C<a class="wx_topic_link" data-topic="1">#实例继续讲解</a></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ModbusTcpPipelinesClient
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _ip;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _port;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Socket _socket;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Pipe _pipe;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task _readTask;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task _writeTask;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CancellationTokenSource _cts;


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 收到完整Modbus报文回调，上位机在这里解析数据</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Action&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[]&gt; OnModbusFrameReceived { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ModbusTcpPipelinesClient(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> ip, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> port = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">502</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            _ip </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ip;
            _port </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> port;
        }


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task ConnectAsync()
        {
            _cts </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CancellationTokenSource();
            _socket </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Socket(AddressFamily.InterNetwork, SocketType.Stream, ProtocolType.Tcp);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _socket.ConnectAsync(_ip, _port, _cts.Token);
            _pipe </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Pipe(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> PipeOptions(pauseWriterThreshold: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4096</span>, resumeWriterThreshold: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2048</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));


            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 两个独立任务：1. Socket收数据写入PipeWriter；2. PipeReader解析报文</span>
            _writeTask =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FillPipeFromSocketAsync(_socket, _pipe.Writer, _cts.Token);
            _readTask </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ParsePipeFramesAsync(_pipe.Reader, _cts.Token);
        }


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 从Socket接收字节，写入PipeWriter（相当于填充缓冲区）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task FillPipeFromSocketAsync(Socket socket, PipeWriter writer, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取一块内存，最小分配512字节，可根据PLC调大小</span>
                    Memory&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>&gt; memory = writer.GetMemory(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">512</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> readLen = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> socket.ReceiveAsync(memory, SocketFlags.None, ct);
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (readLen == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 远端关闭连接</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

                    writer.Advance(readLen); </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 告诉writer实际收到多少字节</span>
                    FlushResult flushResult = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> writer.FlushAsync(ct);
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (flushResult.IsCompleted) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                }
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">接收异常:{ex.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                writer.Complete();
            }
        }


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> PipeReader 循环解析Modbus TCP报文（核心，替代环形缓冲区解析）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task ParsePipeFramesAsync(PipeReader reader, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    ReadResult result </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> reader.ReadAsync(ct);
                    ReadOnlySequence</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>&gt; buffer =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result.Buffer;
                    SequencePosition</span>? consumedPos = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;


                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 循环解析缓冲区里所有完整Modbus帧（处理粘包：一次多个报文）</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (TryParseModbusFrame(buffer, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> frame, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> consumed))
                    {
                        OnModbusFrameReceived</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Invoke(frame.ToArray());
                        consumedPos </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> consumed;
                        buffer </span>= buffer.Slice(consumed); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 切掉已经解析完的数据</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    }


                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AdvanceTo：标记消费位置、查看位置；Pipelines自动回收内存</span>
                    reader.AdvanceTo(consumedPos ??<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> buffer.Start, buffer.End);


                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result.IsCompleted) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                }
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">解析异常:{ex.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                reader.Complete();
            }
        }


        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 尝试从ReadOnlySequence解析ModbusTCP帧
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> MBAP: 7字节 [TransId(2)+ProtoId(2)+Len(2)+UnitId(1)] + PDU
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> TryParseModbusFrame(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> ReadOnlySequence&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>&gt; seq, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> ReadOnlySequence&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>&gt; frame, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SequencePosition consumed)
        {
            frame </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            consumed </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> seq.Start;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (seq.Length &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 不足MBAP头，半包，等待更多数据


            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 读取MBAP第5、6字节：PDU长度</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> headerReader = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> SequenceReader&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(seq);
            headerReader.Advance(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            headerReader.TryReadBigEndian(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">short</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pduLen);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> totalFrameLen = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pduLen;


            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (seq.Length &lt; totalFrameLen) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 收到的数据不够完整报文，等待</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

            frame </span>= seq.Slice(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, totalFrameLen);
            consumed </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> seq.GetPosition(totalFrameLen);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发送Modbus请求</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task SendAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] data)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_socket == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || !_socket.Connected) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未连接PLC</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> sendTotal = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (sendTotal &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data.Length)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> sent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _socket.SendAsync(data.AsMemory(sendTotal), SocketFlags.None);
                sendTotal </span>+=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sent;
            }
        }


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task CloseAsync()
        {
            _cts</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Cancel();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task.WhenAll(_readTask, _writeTask);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> { }
            _socket</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Close();
            _pipe </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<p data-layout-id="2"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>(来自公众号：<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>wacky的碎碎念，违者必究<span>)</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>在上述代码段中，我们把写入和解析作为2个异步方法分开来执行，用于职责分离。</span></p>
<p><span>socket在异步拿到数据后，会告诉PipeWriter实际收到了多少字节，然后把数据提交给PipeReader用于读取。在这一步，socket的职责只有把TCP字节流输入管道中，不做任何的协议解析。</span></p>
<p><span>而在解析的方法中，只负责拿出管道中当前可用的所有数据进行解析，这里引入了ReadOnlySequence的概念，这个类型是代表跨多个内存块的连续逻辑字节流，不需要合并数组。其中又包含一个我们自定义的TryParseModbusFrame方法，用于解析ModbusTCP帧。</span></p>
<p><span>在TryParseModbusFrame方法内部，我们处理了半包或者粘包的场景：</span></p>
<p><span>由于一个完整的MBAP(Modbus TCP)报文头的长度是7字节，因此我们在不足7字节的时候，直接return false，判断此为半包，不会继续进行解析。</span></p>
<p><span>然后我们会计算整个帧的总长度totalFrameLen = 7 + pduLen，这里我们会继续判断收到的数据是否为完整的报文长度，如果不足，那么依然return false，继续等待数据完整后，将buffer切片，输出给调用方。</span></p>
<p><span>最后我们通过AdvanceTo来标记消费位置、查看位置，用于下次继续从指定的位置继续读取，这样我们就可以有效解决TCP存在粘包和半包的问题。</span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="28"><span>后记</span></h1>
<p><span>现代编程语言API的进化总是让人欣喜，直接引入Pipelines就可以避免手写RingBuffer存在的很多问题，可谓是大大提升了效率。但是我们依然还是需要"知其然，知其所以然"，明白了存在什么问题，再去根据问题的本质进行解决，懂得怎么解决之后，再做改进，各位不知今天看懂了吗？下一期，我们再见，诸君共勉。</span></p>

</div>
